notes: Lead from product support team at FjordLight. Small e-comm platform building a chat-based order support assistant and product Q&A. Came in via self-serve; used hosted API. Primary complaint: "occasional latency spikes" affecting EU customers during peak hours (p95 reported ~850-1200ms for generation calls). They sent a short replay (INF-1123) showing long wait times on completion rather than streaming delays. Key constraints: sensitive to per-token cost (tight margins), prefer public cloud (no VPC/private), need SOC2-aligned vendor and SSO. On call they said: "If latency stays above ~500ms p95 users complain". SE notes: Their default timeout in SDK set to 30s; but frontend has a JS timeout of 6s causing client-side failures when model responses delayed. Also noticed prompt templates include whole product descriptions (~3-4k chars) which balloon token count. Recommended immediate tactics: 1) Run POC in us-west-2 (closest Redwood region to their infra) to measure region delta vs eu-west-1, 2) set client timeout to 10s and use server-side streaming to show partial output, 3) trim prompt templates and server-side short summaries for retrieval to keep generation <800 tokens typical, 4) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system messages, 5) use model variant with lower latency benchmark for chat fallback during peaks. POC acceptance criteria: p95 generation <600ms for standard support prompts, no client-timeout errors in web app. Next: SE to provision test key scoped to us-west-2, share step-by-step perf test script and trimmed prompt examples (drive link). Blockers: they want cost estimate for steady-state (50k tokens/mo) and confirmation on SOC2 scope. Pricing deck and security checklist shared (drive).
